svg.text: Empress: unmasked faces and silhouette, refined
From the faces and silhouettes Orb liked. Top: today (the close-up engine's unmasked face). Below: refined. Neutral, hurt and the signature expression. Right: the silhouette today and two small
options. Working labels, pending Legal review.
Silhouette at fight size: today, then two options (colour, then flat black at 90 px)
The mantle spreads to a much wider hem
of points that reaches the knee: a
A wider, lower topknot and a long train
of two blades trailing from the waist
along the floor: height at the head,
Narrower eyes with a thick lash that sweeps out from each corner; one large moss chevron on the cheekbone (the diadem's
mark worn on the face); diadem tabs kept short.
Does the cheek chevron help or crowd the face? Which option reads as more regal, the wide mantle or the crown and train?
